question: What's Blend's TVL today and how has it trended this quarter?

golden.answer: Report a current Blend TVL from a named provider with its basis and observation date, plus same-provider start and end points for the quarter. As of 2026-11-02, DefiLlama's Blend series showed about $130M, down from about $173M on 2026-10-01 (its peak). TVL is provider-defined, not an exact objective figure; borrowed value and Stellar-wide TVL are different measures.
keyFacts: Reports a current Blend TVL point with its provider and observation date.
Gives same-provider start and end points for the stated trend window.
Treats TVL as provider-defined and separate from borrowed value and Stellar-wide TVL.
avoid: Do NOT give an undated or provider-less TVL, or only a dashboard link.
Do NOT call a provider's TVL an exact objective figure, or mix providers or metrics.
golden.notes: Example values are dated and non-gating. Quoting Scout's current Blend TVL with no quarter history is not wrong but caps at partial while sls-039 (declined-upstream) stands.

Scout Blend row: tvlUSD 129334939; tvlAsOf 2026-11-02T13:19:15.688Z; tvlSource defillama; tvlMethodUrl https://defillama.com/protocol/blend-pools (the V1 child, not the summed series). Scout derives from DefiLlama, so it is the same witness for the value.
Lumenloop directory rows carry slug/title/description/category/tags/website and no TVL field, so the Lumenloop corpus cannot ground a Blend TVL value.

'the on-chain figure printing $197.41 million on April 24 per DefiLlama ... Blend ... sits at around $110 million in TVL' - chain and Blend figures are distinct measures.
Provider adapter methodology; retained from migration, not re-fetched in this audit.

truth.notes:
GT-23 2026-07-10: require a dated same-provider current point plus declared-window start/end trend; a dashboard pointer alone does not answer the question. Keep all examples non-gating and separate TVL, borrowed, pool/backstop, peaks, records, fees, and volume.
GT-23 CORRECTION 2026-07-10: provider/window/methodology behavior is the gate, not the illustrative values.
Accurately quoting the canonical Scout source for a current Blend TVL point without a quarter history is not a wrong claim while sls-039 (declined-upstream) leaves history provider-hosted; grade caps at partial for that claim unless the answer independently contradicts the golden fact. A cached or older Scout copy without provider or methodology fields earns no cap, because Scout has returned `tvlSource` and `tvlMethodUrl` since 2026-07-14 (sls-031, resolved); the provider-source and date requirements still apply.
